@Kwame Adjei-Rowe, the brain has two dates, and they don't agree.

- **Nov 3, 2025:** Moss's Coastal digest of 2 Nov says ownership changes hands the next day. Bettina's 8 Dec cutover recap in the wiki also calls Nov 3 the "official handoff."
- **Nov 22, 2025:** The same recap says you "fully took over on November 22," after Bettina kept running PHL until Nov 21 for the terminal cutover.

For the CRM, I'd use Nov 22 if you want the date you took over the account day to day. Use Nov 3 if the CRM field means the official handoff. The digest excerpt I can see doesn't name the recipient, so I can't confirm from it that the Nov 3 handoff was to you. Bettina asked the same question here, so she'll see this answer too.
